edition.title: Data Infra What's New

preheader.en: Langfuse V4 developer experience, DataHub Agent Kafka flows, and smarter RAM alerts — the latest Data Infrastructure product updates.
preheader.zh: Langfuse V4 开发体验、DataHub Agent Kafka 流程、更聪明的 RAM 告警 — Data Infra 最新产品更新。

en: Welcome to the third edition of the Data Infra Monthly Newsletter!

This month is about #OperateSmarter: Langfuse gets a faster, V4-first developer experience, DataHub Agent learns Kafka ingestion flows, and RAM's HDFS alerts become sharper and quieter. Fewer clicks, fewer false alarms, more time for the work that matters.
zh: 欢迎阅读第三期 Data Infra 月报！
本月主题是 #OperateSmarter：Langfuse 带来更快、以 V4 为核心的开发体验，DataHub Agent 学会了 Kafka 数据接入流程，RAM 的 HDFS 告警也更精准、更安静。更少点击、更少误报，把时间留给真正重要的工作。

en.title: Langfuse: September Updates
en.subtitle: di-cli as primary entry point · faster Prompts list · V4 migration alerts · V4.35.0

features.name: di-cli Is Now the Primary Developer Entry Point
features.tag: For developers using CLI or scripts
features.desc: All di-cli reads (traces, observations, sessions, scores) have fully switched to the V4 event aggregation and no longer depend on the Postgres trace_sessions table.

items: Consistent with the V4 single-table model

features.name: Prompts List Query ~9× Faster
features.tag: Projects and teams managing large numbers of prompts
features.desc: We optimized the prompt count used for pagination, reducing query time from ~1,820 ms to ~205 ms. The Prompts list now opens more smoothly while placing less load on the database.

features.name: V4 Migration Alerts for Legacy SDK & API Usage

steps.label: Detect pending work
steps.caption: Legacy SDK/API calls and pending V4 items in each project

steps.label: Show reminder
steps.caption: Appears when you open the project

visual.footnote: Pending items include Experiments, Evals, and Exports.

features.name: Upgraded to Community Langfuse V4.35.0
features.desc: Synced to V4.35.0 this month, keeping the internal platform in lockstep with upstream features and stability improvements.

en.title: RAM: Alert Improvements
en.subtitle: Three changes to HDFS alerts, plus Seatalk private-bot delivery for every alert type.

features.name: Separate Storage and File-Count Usage Alerts
features.desc_source: Storage usage and file-count usage are now alerted separately.

features.name: Multiple Consecutive Rounds of Detection
features.desc_source: An alert now requires several consecutive detection rounds, reducing the false alarm rate.

features.name: Allowed Notification Times per Channel
features.desc_source: Configure the time windows in which each notification channel is allowed to send alerts.

features.name: Seatalk Private Bot Messages
features.desc_source: Alerts of every type can now be received via Seatalk private bot message.

zh.title: RAM：告警优化
zh.subtitle: HDFS 告警的三项改动，加上所有告警类型支援 Seatalk 私信机器人。

features.name: 存储用量与文件数用量告警拆分
features.desc_source: 存储空间用量与文件数用量现在分别告警。

features.name: 连续多轮检测机制
features.desc_source: 需连续多轮检测到才触发告警，降低误报率。

features.name: 各渠道可设置允许通知时间段
features.desc_source: 为不同通知渠道设置允许发送告警的时间。

features.name: Seatalk 私信机器人
features.desc_source: 所有类型的告警都可通过 Seatalk 私信机器人接收。

banner.headline: RAM: HDFS Alert Improvements
